answers.core: Godot famously claim that "Godot is a Godot game", yet you can't re-create Godot interface itself with the currently available nodes.
answers.workaround: I don't think it can be worked around in a few lines... right now the workaround would be litearlly to recreate the inspector from scratch, maybe including C++ code in the same way Godot itself was made.

title: Make Inspector related nodes available for use
